## About
Integra Body Shop & Collision Center operates a complete auto body repair facility in Northlake. Our technicians handle frame and metal work, painting and refinishing, and the final detail before your car goes home.
We'll never leave you in the dark on the repair process. Explaining the details every step of the way is standard to our service. Neighbors who have reviewed us often mention Alex and Jesus by name for keeping them updated and helping sort things out with insurance.
Our in-house Detail Department means your car never has to leave our facility, and we take pride in delivering a clean vehicle with a like-new finish. We're rated 4.6 from 110 Google reviews.

## Services
- Frame, unibody and metal repair: Metal repair and replacement using original replacement parts and factory approved repair procedures where we can, with corrosion protection on every job.
- Painting and refinishing: Matching today's finishes in heated paint booths with Standox Paint.
- Buffing and paint protection: Polishing to remove scratches and old wax, finished with a polymer sealant to protect the paint. Deeper steps are available for heavier scratches and dark vehicles.
- Carpet and upholstery shampoo: Shampoo for carpeting, mats, upholstery and door panels, a vacuumed trunk, and cleaned and conditioned vinyl and leather.
- Hand car wash: A complete hand wash with wheel cleaning, tire dressing, vacuuming, windows, trunk, dash board and door panels.

## FAQ
Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We'll work with your insurance company to arrive at a fair price for quality repairs.

Q: Can you pick up my car?
A: Yes. We provide free pick up and delivery of vehicles and offer a courtesy shuttle to your workplace.

Q: How do I pay?
A: We accept all major credit cards and personal checks.

Q: Why might an estimate take a little longer?
A: To get the estimate right the first time, we sometimes need to do minor disassembly of the damaged area.
